kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نخرنطم (form IIIq)
# نَخْرَنْطِمُ (naḵranṭimu) /nax.ran.tˤi.mu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِخْرَنْطَمَ (iḵranṭama)
# نَخْرَنْطِمَ (naḵranṭima) /nax.ran.tˤi.ma/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِخْرَنْطَمَ (iḵranṭama)
# نَخْرَنْطِمْ (naḵranṭim) /nax.ran.tˤim/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِخْرَنْطَمَ (iḵranṭama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
